a=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)
h,w,_=a.shape
# classify each cell in a coarse grid
for yy in range(0,h,4):
    line=''
    for xx in range(0,w,4):
        block=a[yy:yy+4,xx:xx+4].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        r,g,b=block
        if r<45 and g<45 and b<45: c='#'   # black
        elif r>120 and g>110 and b<90 and abs(r-g)<45: c='y' # yellow tennis
        elif r>g+15 and g>=b: c='b'  # brown wood
        elif abs(r-g)<18 and abs(g-b)<18: c='.'  # gray
        elif g>r+8 and g>b+8: c='g'
        else: c='?'
        line+=c
    print('%3d '%yy+line)
